doc: test_qa_walk_audit.gd (the Lead's 10-29 list, item 4): scripted walks of the real party through Act I's stairs and narrow paths, driven through the real FieldController (stick toward each waypoint, as a player would) with the live camera director. Per route: start (a spawn, a stage mark or a point), the waypoints (xz pairs at the walker's height, xyz points, a stairs row's foot/head, or a ramp chain from the zone's collision file), run (a full stick) or walk, and the flags set first. Limits (the audit fails past them) and what it only reports: see the test's header.
